ns2:course.label: Engineering Materials
ns2:course.description: Structures of polymers, metals, and ceramics as the basis for their mechanical behavior. Manipulation of structure through processes such as heat treatment and solidification. Mechanisms of material failure in service (yielding, fracture, fatigue, creep, corrosion, and wear) and simple design techniques to avoid these failures. Strategies for material selection in design. Credit is not given for both ME 330 and either MSE 280 or TAM 324 / CEE 300. Prerequisite: TAM 251 and CHEM 104.
